description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom Android TextView widget for displaying log data received through the LogNode interface. It includes methods for formatting and appending log messages, as well as handling log chain chaining.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: Custom TextView subclass for displaying logs, implementing LogNode interface, formatting log messages, and chaining log nodes.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats the log message based on priority, tag, message, and throwable, then appends it to the LogView and passes it to the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method to append a non-null string to a StringBuilder, with delimiter handling.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line in the LogView.
